Subject: Triple-zone technical playback + load rehearsal — initial availability

Hi Maya,

Thanks again for agreeing to a hands-on playback ahead of the integration sprint. To make the session useful for both engineering and SRE sides, we want to run:
- a 30–45m prompt review + routing walkthrough,
- a 45m staged load rehearsal (ramping to target QPS), and
- short time to validate fallback/quantization behavior.

Proposed rotating windows (teams pick 1 rotation to observe / join):
- Rotation A (US-friendly): 2026-11-10 09:00–12:00 PT (covers US morning)
- Rotation B (EU-friendly): 2026-11-11 13:00–16:00 CET (covers EU afternoon)
- Rotation C (APAC-friendly): 2026-11-12 21:00–23:30 SGT (covers APAC evening)

Attached is a short agenda (playback-agenda.pdf). If these windows don't work, tell us your preferred blocks and we can reschedule. For the load rehearsal we plan three ramps: smoke, 50% target, 100% target. Please confirm your target QPS and any service-hours blackout constraints.

Next steps: once we agree on rotation winners, Jasmine will send invites and the loadtest-config.yaml. Rishi will validate capacity.

Thanks — happy to iterate on times.

—
Neha Kapoor
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0197

Neha —

Thanks for the clear agenda. Quick constraints from my side:
- We can't do the APAC window on 11/12 (several infra folks are on-call rotation that night).
- For EU, 13:00–16:00 CET is tight because of meetings; would 14:00–17:00 CET work instead?
- Target QPS for the rehearsal: our target for peak is ~350 qps for the routing path we'd like to exercise. We can start with a smoke at 10 qps, then 175 qps, then 350 qps.

If you can propose an APAC-adjacent evening (11/13 or 11/14) that would be better for our folks.

Appreciate you including the ramps — can Jasmine share the load config when available?

Cheers,
Maya Lin

Looping in quick confirmation:
- Dedicated pool has been reserved for the three rotations and can run short bursts to 400 qps for <10m windows given current capacity.
- Recommended production rehearsal profile per our runtime notes: 30s spike, 5m hold at 50% (175 qps), 2m spike to 100% (350 qps), then 10m cool-down.
- If the customer prefers more gradual ramps, we can use the canary plan Jasmine suggested (200 qps), but capacity is available for your target profile.

Also: I'll join Rotation A (US) and Rotation C (APAC) handoffs — can take the first 30m of the load run to monitor KV cache behavior and memory growth.

—Rishi
